This 2008 Chevrolet Impala LT offers reliable midsize sedan performance with practical features designed for everyday driving. The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements any lifestyle. With 71,310 miles on the odometer, this vehicle demonstrates moderate use and remains well-maintained for years of dependable service ahead.

- Front 40/20/40 split-bench seating with cloth trim
- Flip-and-fold flat rear seat for flexible cargo management
- 4-wheel antilock disc brakes with all-speed traction control
- AM/FM stereo with XM satellite radio and CD/MP3 playback
- Six-speaker audio system
- Front dual-zone automatic air conditioning
- Power driver seat with adjustable positioning
- Tilt steering wheel
- Power windows and power door mirrors
- Remote keyless entry
- Speed control for highway comfort
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 16-inch alloy wheels
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- OnStar Safe & Sound emergency communication system

The 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 4-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance with fuel efficiency, achieving 18 city and 29 highway miles per gallon. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides confident handling in various driving conditions while maintaining a spacious interior cabin.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, occupant-sensing technology, and overhead airbag protection. The 4-wheel antilock braking system with traction control enhances stability and prevents wheel lockup during emergency stops. Emergency communication capabilities through OnStar provide additional peace of mind during your travels.

Interior comfort includes climate control with front dual zones, allowing driver and passenger to set individual temperatures. Power-operated windows and mirrors enhance convenience, while the adjustable power driver seat accommodates various body types. The tilt steering column enables personalized positioning for improved comfort during extended drives.

The versatile seating configuration adapts to your needs, with the rear flip-and-fold design creating additional cargo space when needed. This practical layout supports both passenger comfort and transportation flexibility for everyday responsibilities.

This Impala LT combines functional design with reliable engineering, offering a straightforward ownership experience. Contact our team today to schedule a showing and evaluate this vehicle for your transportation needs.
